page.overview:
Who is Herugar Bolger?

Herugar Bolger was a Hobbit of the Shire.

Herugar was Rudigar Bolger and Belba Bolger's son and only child. He was the grandson of Mungo Baggins and Laura Grubb, and a cousin of Bilbo Baggins.

He was born in TA 2895 and died in TA 2990, aged 95. He married Jessamine Boffin and had one son, Odovacar Bolger.
